info.title: belo as a Service
info.description:
# belo as a Service

Programmatic access to belo's crypto and fiat rails for businesses. Move balances,
read deposit addresses, convert between currencies and charge your customers with
belo pay — reusable payment links or single-use one-time payments — over the same
infrastructure that powers belo, through a single REST API with JSON requests and
responses.

## Base URL

| Environment | Base URL |
|---|---|
| Staging | `https://b2b.stgbelo.app` |

All endpoints live under `/api/v1`.

## Authentication

Every request is authenticated with an **API key** that belo issues to your
organization. Send it on the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: ApiKey belo_live_<your-key>
```

The key identifies your organization, and its permissions are configured by belo
when the key is issued, according to your agreement — there is nothing to
configure or send besides the `Authorization` header. A missing or invalid key —
or one used against an operation outside your agreement — returns
`401 unauthenticated`. To enable additional operations, contact belo.

## Idempotency

Money-moving requests (`POST`/`PUT` on swaps and transfers, `POST`/`DELETE`
on payments) and end-user registration (`POST /end-users`) require an
`Idempotency-Key` header. Retrying with the same key and
payload returns the original result instead of repeating the operation; reusing a
key with a different payload is rejected. Keys are retained for 24 hours.

## Response envelope

- **Single resource** — returned as the object directly.
- **Collection** — wrapped as `{ "data": [ ... ] }`.
- **Error** — `{ "error": { "type": "...", "code": "...", "message": "..." } }`.

Branch on the stable `code` (and the coarser `type`); the human `message` may
change and should not be parsed. See the error reference on each endpoint for the
codes it can return.

## Amounts

Monetary amounts are decimal **strings**, never floating-point numbers, to avoid
rounding error.

## Versioning

The API is versioned in the path (`/api/v1`). Backwards-compatible changes are
additive; breaking changes ship under a new version segment.

total.description: Lifetime accrued yield, as a decimal string in the currency decimals

today.description: Accrued since midnight, cut by the server timezone

month.description: Accrued since the 1st of the month, cut by the server timezone

rate.description: Annual rate the yield engine accrues, as a percentage string

extraYield.description: Campaign boost on top of `rate`, paid as separate reward transactions. Only present while a campaign applies.

available.description: Available balance as a decimal string

earned.description: Yield the currency already accrued. Always present, zeroed when there is none — unlike `yield`.

yield.description: Yield the currency pays. Absent when it pays none — which is not the same as 0%.

details.description: Structured data the client needs to act on; only present on the codes that define it

name.description: Name of who sent (deposit) or receives (transfer, pix withdrawal)

bank.description: Bank or institution of the account

account.description: CVU, CBU, alias, pix key or on-chain address. Null on rails where the value is not a public account (belo user, email, QR)

currency.description: Balance the funds are taken from

amount.description: Amount taken from that balance, fee and taxes included

price.description: Price of one base in quote

counterparty.description: Who sent or receives. Null for a swap and for an on-chain deposit

debits.description: What left each balance, fee and taxes included. Empty when nothing was debited

netAmount.description: Amount before fee and taxes: what was credited, or what the recipient got

netCurrency.description: As the app receipt prints it: a peso deposit reads ARGt

conversion.description: The conversion applied, when the movement converted between currencies

explorerUrl.description: Block explorer link of an on-chain movement

bankReference.description: Reference of the bank rail: Coelsa id (Argentina) or pix end-to-end id

currency.description: Currency the amount is denominated in

metadata.description: Echo of the request parameters: address/addressType for transfers, pairCode/type for swaps

receipt.description: What the belo app receipt shows for this movement, fresh from the ledger. Null when the ledger could not be read

quoteAmount.description: Amount denominated in the quote currency, as a decimal string

quoteCurrency.description: Currency code the amount is denominated in

id.description: Transaction id — use it to confirm the swap

addressType.description: Pass it as `addressType` to the transfer preview

available.description: Whether sending over this network is enabled right now

address.description: Destination address — loki validates it for the rail

addressType.description: Rail the destination address belongs to

quoteAmount.description: Amount denominated in the quote currency, as a decimal string

base.description: Currency of the "1" side, the larger unit

quote.description: Currency the rate is expressed in

id.description: Transaction id — use it to confirm the transfer

amount.description: What the destination receives, before fee and taxes. What actually leaves each balance is in `debits`

exchangeRate.description: Rate of the conversion between the balance debited and the currency sent, when there is one. Null when no conversion applies or both sides are the same money (ARGt and ARS)

debits.description: What the transfer takes out of each balance, one entry per currency — more than one when it is funded from several balances. Fee and taxes are included. Empty when it is not known.

max.description: Maximum payable amount, as a decimal string

currencyCode.description: Currency the limits are denominated in

key.description: Stable key for the payment method

feeRate.description: Fee rate applied to the payment

minFeeAmount.description: Minimum fee amount, as a decimal string

imageUrl.description: Logo URL for the payment method

transactionId.description: Transaction id the status was resolved for; null when querying the link itself

canceled.description: Whether the payment link was canceled

name.description: Recipient name as the pix directory reports it

address.description: Destination pix key — the provider validates it against the directory

amount.description: Amount in BRL as a decimal string. An EMV QR code that carries its own amount overrides it.

id.description: Transaction id — use it to confirm the payout

amount.description: Total in the currency the payout settles from, not BRL. What actually leaves each balance is in `debits`

fee.description: Payout fee, followed by its currency when known

exchangeRate.description: Rate between the currency the payout settles from and BRL, e.g. 1 USDT ≈ 5.40 BRL. Null when loki does not price it or both sides are the same money (BRAt and BRL)

debits.description: What the payout takes out of each balance, one entry per currency — more than one when it is funded from several balances. Empty when it is not known.

status.description: Settlement is async — a confirmed payout starts as pending

acceptedTerms.description: Attestation that the organization accepted belo's pix payout terms of service, shown in your UI. Must be `true`.
Whether the organization has accepted the pix payout terms

id.description: Card id — use it to list its movements or to freeze and unfreeze it

lastFour.description: Last four digits of the card number

type.description: The API only creates virtual cards; physical ones can still be listed

status.description: `frozen` cards reject new charges until unfrozen. `unknown` is a provider status this API does not map yet.

canFreeze.description: Whether the provider currently accepts a freeze or unfreeze for this card

status.description: Where the organization stands with the card issuer. Cards can only be issued while `approved`. `unknown` is an issuer status this API does not map yet.

acceptedTerms.description: Whether the issuer's terms of service were accepted with the application. With `status: not_started` it is always `false` because no application was ever submitted — it is not a refusal of the terms.

status.description: An authorization stays pending until it settles or is reversed

amount.description: Amount as a decimal string, denominated in `currency`

currency.description: Currency the amount is denominated in

description.description: Merchant or concept as the provider reports it

name.description: Label for the card. The provider assigns one when omitted.

annualRevenue.description: Declared yearly income of the organization, as a bracket in USD.

monthlyCardSpend.description: Expected monthly spend across the organization's cards, as a bracket in USD.

acceptedTerms.description: Attestation that the organization accepted the card issuer's terms of service, shown in your UI. Must be `true`.

key.description: Field key as the provider names it

displayValue.description: Human readable value when the field is a choice

addressType.description: Address type, in the same vocabulary as the transfer endpoints (`CBU`, `ALIAS`, `PIX`, `BELOTAG`, a crypto network...)

address.description: The address itself: a CBU, alias, pix key, belotag, wallet...

country.description: Destination country of an international account

fields.description: Beneficiary data of an international account; empty for any other address

ownerName.description: Account holder name as the bank reports it

belotag.description: belo username when the contact is a belo user

tier.description: Group the contact is ranked in: `self` (own accounts), `favorite`, `frequent`. `unknown` when the address book is not ranked.

name.description: Name the organization gave the vault

goalAmount.description: Savings goal as a decimal string in the vault currency

balance.description: Current balance as a decimal string

isYieldActive.description: Whether the vault is accruing yield right now

rate.description: Annual rate the yield engine applies to the vault, as a percentage string. `"0.00%"` when the currency pays no yield.

total.description: Lifetime accrued yield, as a decimal string

balance.description: Current balance as a decimal string

isYieldActive.description: Whether the vault is accruing yield right now

rate.description: Annual rate the yield engine applies to the vault, as a percentage string. `"0.00%"` when the currency pays no yield.

earned.description: Yield the vault already accrued, per window. Always present, zeroed when none.

pep.description: The end user is a politically exposed person (PEP): holds a public office or is a relative of someone who does. Required in AR and BR.

obligatedSubject.description: The end user is an obligated subject (sujeto obligado) under local AML rules: their profession or usual activity is exposed to money laundering. Required in AR.

usTaxResident.description: The end user is a US tax resident (FATCA): green card or substantial presence, i.e. more than 6 months in the US during the fiscal year. Required in AR and BR.

country.description: Country of residence, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Only countries enabled for the API are accepted (AR and BR today).

documentNumber.description: National identity document number, as the app asks at sign-up: DNI (7 or 8 digits) for Argentina, CPF (11 digits, check digits verified) for Brazil. Digits only, no mask.

externalReference.description: Your own identifier for this end user. Unique within your organization.

signedAgreementId.description: Proof that the end user accepted belo's terms: the id the hosted acceptance page handed back (`POST /terms/links`). It must belong to your organization and to the same country, be used within 24 h of the acceptance, and registers a single end user.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason for the current status. For `rejected`: `RETRY` means the end user can resubmit through a new KYC session, `FINAL` that they cannot, `DUPLICATE` that the document already belongs to another belo account, and `UNDERAGE` that the document shows a minor.

accepted.description: Whether the end user accepted belo's terms

acceptedAt.description: When the end user accepted on the hosted page. Null only for end users registered before the hosted acceptance existed.

obligatedSubject.description: Obligated subject under local AML rules

existingAccount.description: True when the email already belonged to a belo user before you registered them. Their data is not visible and cannot be changed through this API; KYC status and sessions work.

pendingData.description: What is still missing before the KYC can start; send it with `PATCH /end-users/:id`. Empty means a KYC session can be created.

existingAccount.description: True when the email already belonged to a belo user before you registered them. Their data is not visible and cannot be changed through this API; KYC status and sessions work.

pep.description: The end user is a politically exposed person (PEP): holds a public office or is a relative of someone who does. Required in AR and BR.

obligatedSubject.description: The end user is an obligated subject (sujeto obligado) under local AML rules: their profession or usual activity is exposed to money laundering. Required in AR.

usTaxResident.description: The end user is a US tax resident (FATCA): green card or substantial presence, i.e. more than 6 months in the US during the fiscal year. Required in AR and BR.

number.description: Full number in E.164 format, including the leading `+`

country.description: Country the number belongs to, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Must match the number.

zipCode.description: Argentina: 3 to 8 letters or digits, no hyphen (`C1043AAZ`). Brazil: CEP as `00000-000`.

region.description: Province or state name as belo lists it: one of the 24 Argentine provinces (`Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires`, `Córdoba`, …) or the 27 Brazilian states (`São Paulo`, `Minas Gerais`, …). Validated against the end user country.

annualSalary.description: Yearly income range in USD. Not collected in Argentina or Brazil.

redirectUrl.description: Where the end user is sent after submitting the verification (https). Required when `rejectUrl` is set.

rejectUrl.description: Where the end user is sent if the submission cannot be completed (https). Only with `redirectUrl`.

url.description: Hosted verification URL to open for the end user. Reusable until it expires.

title.description: Title in the language of the country

country.description: Country of the end user, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Decides the documents and the language.

redirectUri.description: Where the end user is sent after accepting, with `signed_agreement_id` appended as a query parameter. An absolute URL whose origin is in your organization allowlist. Without it the id is delivered by `postMessage` to the allowlisted origins, so the page must be embedded.

url.description: Hosted acceptance page to open for the end user (iframe, WebView or new tab)
